thread:
maya: Hey team — just unpacked my new MBP (M2) and after the Ventura update the device is stuck on 'Applying profile' during MDM enrollment. Been waiting ~20 mins. anyone seen this?

sam: ugh. can you ping the wifi captive portal? sometimes that blocks enrollment. are you on office guest or VPN?

maya: On home wifi, not on VPN. No captive portal. I saw a spinner and occasional 'profile install failed' toast then it went back to Applying.

andrew: do you have the serial? I can look up if Kandji has a pending command.

maya: serial C02ZQ0XXXXXX (DM me if you need full)

it-support: @maya we'll try the quick checks: 1) reboot and hold Option to ensure no external drives, 2) remove any leftover profiles in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Profiles if accessible, 3) try wired ethernet or phone hotspot. also sending you temporary admin creds now via DM.

mdm-bot: Automated note: device C02ZQ0XXXXXX shows 'enrollment: failed_retry' in the last 30m. Last server response: 403 during profile fetch.

sam: 403 sounds like token or cert issue. maya, can you share the mdm enrollment URL shown on the screen?

maya: it's enroll.redwood-example.kandji.com/XXXXX

andrew: thanks. @it-support this matches a short window where our onboarding cert rotated yesterday. I pushed a retry policy but some devices need the web-enroll flow. maya try this: connect to a phone hotspot, open Safari, go to https://enroll.redwood-example.kandji.com/XXXXX and follow the web enrollment. should force a fresh profile pull.

maya: ok trying hotspot now...

maya: quick note: Safari shows a 'Profile downloaded' banner, then in Settings it still shows "Applying profile" for a while, then an error 'Verification failed'.

sam: can you paste the device log snippet? you can open Console.app -> Action -> Include System Logs and filter for 'mdm' or 'profiles'. if not, try running:

```
sudo profiles renew -type enrollment
sudo tail -n 200 /var/log/install.log | grep -i profile
```

maya: running the commands now, here's the tail output (copied):

```
Mar 12 11:03:45 MacBook-Pro profilesd[123]: Profile install: started
Mar 12 11:03:47 MacBook-Pro profilesd[123]: Profile install: verification failed: certificate trust
Mar 12 11:03:47 MacBook-Pro profilesd[123]: Profile install: removed temporary
```

andrew: yep certificate trust. likely the new cert bundle isn't trusted yet on that image. two paths: (A) use web-enroll and when Safari prompts, manually accept the certificate (not ideal), or (B) we send you a signed enrollment plist via DM that uses the fallback cert.

it-support: I'll create a one-time fallback enrollment link and post it here in a sec.

it-support: fallback link sent to @maya via DM. also granted temporary admin until EOD. try the link and reboot after profile installs.

maya: clicked the fallback link, profile installed, and now I see 'MDM enrolled' 🎉. thanks all.

sam: nice. can you confirm FileVault is enabled and the encryption recovery key is stored in Okta?

maya: FileVault prompt showed during first boot and I enabled it. Okta shows device serial and a recovery key entry.

andrew: perfect. I'll mark the device as provisioned in the inventory and close the ticket. note for infra: follow-up to rotate the cert rollout to avoid web-enroll.

maya: huge thanks — first-week question answered :)

it-support: closing notes: root cause = cert rotation + Ventura timing. mitigation = fallback one-time enrollment + retry policy. reopening if it reoccurs. :thumbsup:
